title: Affine fan-center inputs and normalized tensor-chart comparisons
statement: For an fs log scheme V, a characteristic fan chart c:V -> F and a fan ideal J, an affine-center input consists of an affine scheme open U=Spec A, a sharp fs monoid P, a log chart P -> N(U), a fan open S(P) -> F, a factorization of c on U, the equality of the sharpened section germs with the canonical fan germs, and a finite nonempty generating set E for J on that fan open. It does not assume that these sections generate the pulled-back log ideal. Given that stalkwise generation equality, idealChart is the recorded LogIdealAffineChart with exactly this data. For its saturated tensor cover C over b:V' -> V and a in E, sharpChart is the restriction of V'.sharpSpace along the open tensor-chart map, sharpChartInclusion its canonical inclusion, and ringChart the actual structural monomials on Spec(A tensor Z[R_a]). logChartUnitFace is the inverse image of local-ring units. IsGeometricComparison requires the ordinary sharp-stalk equivalence to send every ambient Zariski log-section germ to its actual geometric characteristic class. All definitions are relocated from the parent module with unchanged names, signatures and bodies.
